sender.en: A seller on Facebook or WhatsApp

name.en: Fake seller asks for a deposit to hold an item

how.en: A seller on social media advertises an item such as a fridge or appliance, often below the normal price. They offer to hold it for you if you send a deposit to a bank account in someone else’s name and send a screenshot as proof. When you go to collect it, the seller gives excuses, a vague location, and then stops answering. Belize Police say these scams are common on Facebook and WhatsApp.

text.en: An item is advertised on social media, often cheaper than usual.
The seller asks for a deposit to hold it and a screenshot of the transfer.
The account for payment belongs to a third person, not the seller.
After you pay, there is no item and the seller disappears.

Yes hun the fridge is still available, 3 ppl asking for it. If you want I hold it for you, just do a $200 deposit to my cousin account at the bank and send me the screenshot. Then you can pick up tomorrow in Orange Walk.
